messages:
maria: Kicking off the joint perf/W + throughput validation with HaloEdge. Goal: get a reproducible baseline and one kernel tuning pass by the end of next week. Quick sync on who's doing what.
aditya: I can own the Redwood harness side (load profiles + telemetry). Planning to run the standard runcase and a 99th-percentile trace.
lina: HaloEdge will provide three firmware builds and two kernel patches — we'll test all combos. I'll ship the artifacts to the shared s3 bucket tonight.
maria: Great. Can we agree on the acceptance criteria? I propose: 1) >=5% throughput uplift or >=10% watt reduction for any tuned variant, 2) no >5% regression on latency p95, 3) perf artifacts + plots in the PR.
aditya: Agreed. Also add: cost-per-1M-requests delta and a small table comparing quant modes (fp16 / int8).
chris: I'll handle the power instrumentation and thermal baseline. Need to confirm the sensor mapping on the test rack — @lina can you confirm the BMC/IPMI creds?
lina: Sent creds to the secure vault and DM'd chris. Rack IDs: HE-12A and HE-12B. Note: HE-12B has a firmware quirk that affects power sampling above 85% load — will annotate results.
aditya: For telemetry schema, let's standardize on these tags: model, sequence_len, batch_size, quant_mode, kernel_patch_id, firmware_id, rack_id. I'll paste the run command snippet we'll use so results are parseable.
aditya: ```
# run harness (example)
./redwood-bench --model llama-70b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --quant int8 --kernel v2 --out results/haloedge_v2.json
```
maria: Perfect. @perf-bot, start the dry-run checklist and notify when artifacts land.
perf-bot: dry-run checklist created: /playbooks/bench/dryrun-haloedge. Tasks: (1) validate harness, (2) verify power sensors, (3) smoke run, (4) collect traces. ETA: 24h.
chris: Heads-up: for the smoke run tomorrow we'll cap at 60% sustained load to avoid the HE-12B sampling issue. Full sweep after firmware patch.
lina: Understood. We'll push firmware patch tonight and schedule a maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
aditya: One more item — plots. We want: throughput vs power (line), latency CDF, and a small diff heatmap across kernel flags. I'll prepare a notebook that consumes results/*.json and outputs PNGs ready for PR.
maria: Ownership summary: aditya = harness + plots, chris = power + smoke runs, lina = artifacts + firmware, maria = acceptance + announcement plan. Deliverables and dates: dry-run artifacts in 48h, tuned-run + plots by next Friday COB.
lina: Sounds good. Any concerns on data sharing / NDA? HaloEdge legal confirmed this one-off bench can be published jointly as long as we run the agreed disclosure text. I'll attach the blurb to the shared folder.
aditya: I'll add an eval that checks prompt-level correctness to ensure quant/kernel changes don't degrade quality beyond 1% perplexity delta.
maria: Awesome. If nothing blocks, we'll go ahead with the dry run tonight. Ping me on results. :rocket: :thumbsup:
chris: On it, launching smoke in ~2h. I'll post logs to the thread.
perf-bot: smoke run started on HE-12A. job_id=job_3843210187. Logs: s3://redwood-bench/haloedge/smoke/job_3843210187.log
aditya: Logged. I'll subscribe to that S3 path and start parsing once complete.
lina: Thanks team — happy to do a postmortem after the tuned pass.
maria: Thanks all — great cross-org move. We should file a short announcement draft after results are thumbs-up.
chris: smoke run complete, baseline numbers attached in the log. Quick peek: throughput 12.3k TPS, avg power 420W, p95 latency 210ms. Dropping logs here: s3://redwood-bench/haloedge/smoke/job_3843210187.log
aditya: Received. Starting automated parse now; will post parsed CSV + initial plots in ~45m.
maria: Perfect — will wait for the plots before confirming the tuned sweep cadence.
